_doc: Linux (`platform: linux`) entries for libtier0.so of build 2000908, the one module whose game
classes are still symbolized: `.dynsym` there carries `_ZTV` symbols for a handful of tier0
utilities (CThread, CUtlCharConversion, the KeyValues dump contexts, the format-output-stream
family), which is what the `itanium_vtable` locator resolves: the address point of the vtable is
the `_ZTV…` symbol + 16 (the symbol names the group's [offset-to-top][typeinfo] header, and its
st_size covers header + slots, so st_size/8 - 2 is the length the linker records).
These are the upstream classes the comparison in the S2 report uses: their Itanium VTLEN is
fixed by the upstream header (crates/s2sdk/s2sdk-sys/UPSTREAM.lock), so the measured game length is a
cross-check of upstream's numbers against the shipped Linux binary. The s2sdk IR's own vtable
classes (IAppSystem, ISchemaSystem, ICvar, IGameEvent…) are pure interfaces with no emitted
vtable in any staged Linux module and no `_ZTV` symbol - a probe over all staged modules found
0 of 11 - so no entry can be added for them (S2 report).
Nothing here has a `bridge` macro: the bridge gate covers the Windows entries only.

IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText.via: libtier0.so `_ZTV27IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText` = 0x4a70b0 (st_size 56): the exported Itanium vtable of IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText (upstream public/tier0/keyvalues.h:520), first virtual function at 0x4a70c0
IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText.notes: upstream Itanium VTLEN 5 (KvBeginKey, KvWriteValue, KvEndKey, KvWriteIndent, KvWriteText - keyvalues.h:515-529); the game's symbol length is 5 too (st_size 56 = 16 + 5*8). The code-pointer scan gives 4, because the last slot (pure KvWriteText) is a null in this table rather than a thunk: the `vtlen` scan under-counts a table it ends on, `measure: symbol` does not (S2 report, VTLEN_IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText)

VTLEN_IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText.notes: MATCH: upstream Itanium VTLEN for IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText is 5 (public/tier0/keyvalues.h:515-529, one entry per virtual, no virtual destructor)

CKeyValuesDumpContextAsDevMsg.via: libtier0.so `_ZTV29CKeyValuesDumpContextAsDevMsg` = 0x4a70e8 (st_size 56): the exported Itanium vtable of CKeyValuesDumpContextAsDevMsg (upstream public/tier0/keyvalues.h:532), first virtual function at 0x4a70f8
CKeyValuesDumpContextAsDevMsg.notes: upstream Itanium VTLEN 5 (IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText's five virtuals, two of them overridden here - keyvalues.h:523-540); the game's st_size gives 5 as well, and here the code-pointer scan agrees (no null slot)

VTLEN_CKeyValuesDumpContextAsDevMsg.notes: MATCH: upstream Itanium VTLEN for CKeyValuesDumpContextAsDevMsg is 5 (keyvalues.h:532-541; it overrides KvBeginKey and KvWriteText of IKeyValuesDumpContextAsText)

CTestScriptMgr.via: libtier0.so!0x248780 (CTestScriptMgr complete-object destructor, Itanium vtable slot 17: its first instruction after the prologue is lea rax,[rip+vtable address point]). No `_ZTV` symbol is exported for the class (typeinfo name 14CTestScriptMgr, typeinfo 0x4ABDC8, address point 0x4ABDF0 per s2sdk-types RE1 section 5)
CTestScriptMgr.notes: ITestScriptMgr implementation (the TestScriptMgr001 singleton), single table, offset-to-top 0; the Windows build's table has 18 entries, the Itanium one 19 because the destructor has two slots

VTLEN_CTestScriptMgr.via: libtier0.so address point 0x4ABDF0: 19 .text slot pointers (slots 0-18; 17 = complete dtor 0x248780, 18 = deleting dtor 0x2489F0) up to the next table's header
VTLEN_CTestScriptMgr.notes: Itanium length of ITestScriptMgr's implementation, compared by sdkcheck.py against upstream's Itanium vtable length of ITestScriptMgr (19)
